newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Samsung Elec shares fall to year-low.
newsitem.headline: Samsung Elec shares fall to year-low.

text.p: Shares in Samsung Electronics, a unit of the Samsung Group, fell to their 1996 low of 59,000 won per share in early morning trading on Friday, on back of continued poor outlooks for global DRAM prices, brokers said.
By 10:35 a.m. (0135 GMT) the shares had regained some ground, to trade at 59,700 won, down 600 on the day.
According to local traders, talk that Japanese semiconductor firms were selling 16-megabit DRAM chips at $9.30 sent the shares falling sharply. The price could not be confirmed.
"There are also rumours that Taiwanese makers are willing to go as low as $4, which is really hurting the mood," said a First Securities broker.
The international spot price for 16 megabit DRAMs fell to $12 a unit in August from $50.1 a year ago.
